notes: Identity: SOURCE https://osf.io/fqdh4/download matches url_r. Substantive primary replication-results report with Table 1, Figure 1 placeholder, preregistration deviations and materials descriptions; cites Einstein and Glick (2017), exact original title and AJPS 61(1):100–116. Same public housing correspondence experiment. No replication title, author byline, date or DOI is printed; Weller et al. authorship/date cannot be independently confirmed from the supplied text. No PDF supplied; Figure 1 graphic is absent from text. Missing descriptions and locators prevent selecting a model. ser_method does not establish metric identity. Printed Hispanic Alias logit coefficients in columns 1–4 are 0.098, 0.051, 0.104, 0.051, with SEs 0.149, 0.114, 0.149, 0.115. Prose explicitly associates column 1 with p=0.511,z=0.66 and column 3 with p=0.483,z=0.70. It also gives p=0.657,z=0.44 while describing columns 1 and 2, and p=0.654,z=0.45 while describing columns 3 and 4; this wording is not repaired by numeric matching. Table 1 Observations: 738, 1,243, 738, 1,243; its note inconsistently says draws out of 1234, whereas prose says 1,243. Repeated two-sided linear probability models draw 738 from 1,484 responses, repeat 1,000 times, and report approximately 93 percent nonsignificance. This aggregate is not an individual test p; no individual LPM coefficient/p appears in that paragraph. Recruitment 3,050 and total responses 1,811 do not select an analytic sample. No N sum, df inference or metric conversion performed. All assigned values null because target model is ambiguous. Original and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
